# Evaluated Applications

> Data that answers in microseconds and language models that run in a browser tab. .NET libraries you add with one command, and tools to try now. Proprietary. Every package ships as a compiled library. Evaluation and non-commercial development or testing are permitted; commercial, production or revenue-generating use needs a commercial licence from the owner.

Updated: 2026-10-17

## Products

- [Phasor](https://evaluatedapplications.github.io/phasor/): Build stores that answer exactly, replicas that sync by their differences and tables that repair themselves. One pass applies a thousand operators. `dotnet add package EvaluatedApplications.Phasor` (release 2.19.1).
- [EvalApp](https://evaluatedapplications.github.io/evalapp/): Run everything at once without overloading anything. Gates on every resource, sagas that undo failures, and a tuner that finds the right speed. `dotnet add package EvaluatedApplications.EvalApp` (release 4.4.1).
- [HoloDb](https://evaluatedapplications.github.io/holodb/): A SQL database inside your app that answers dashboard queries in microseconds, with transactions, similarity search and tables bigger than memory. `dotnet add package EvaluatedApplications.HoloDb` (release 5.3.0).
- [AlgFormer](https://evaluatedapplications.github.io/algformer/): Train and run language models in plain C#. The holographic attention core reads long prompts in a fraction of the time. `dotnet add package EvaluatedApplications.AlgFormer` (release 3.3.0).
- [Prism](https://evaluatedapplications.github.io/prism/): A model that remembers how it grew. A confidence-gated decoder and a journal of every change, behind the Prism chat tool. `dotnet add package EvaluatedApplications.Prism` (release 1.3.4).
- [Prose](https://evaluatedapplications.github.io/prose/): Three novels in, nearly two thousand checked new sentences out. Mines grammar into HoloDb and recombines it into text and question and answer pairs. `dotnet add package EvaluatedApplications.Prose` (release 1.4.0).
- [HoloGenome](https://evaluatedapplications.github.io/hologenome/): Turn DNA into a vector that winds like the real helix, then check it against laboratory measurements it never saw. The wins and the losses are published. `dotnet add package EvaluatedApplications.HoloGenome` (release 0.1.1).
- [Tracer](https://evaluatedapplications.github.io/tracer/): Send a whole crowd to one exit with a single search. Navmesh pathfinding with dynamic obstacles, line of sight and combat. `dotnet add package EvaluatedApplications.Tracer` (release 2.0.2).
- [HoloVoxel](https://evaluatedapplications.github.io/holovoxel/): Voxel worlds that stay crisp up close and cost almost nothing far away, with no mesh tiers and no popping. `dotnet add package EvaluatedApplications.HoloVoxel` (release 1.5.2).
- [Blazier](https://evaluatedapplications.github.io/blazier/): Blazor pages that read at once and download .NET only when a visitor presses Start, with long C# jobs in a Web Worker. `dotnet add package EvaluatedApplications.Blazier` (release 1.1.0).

## Tools

- [The Dashboard](https://evaluatedapplications.github.io/tools/dashboard/): A live dashboard over a database that lives in your browser tab. Pick the size, click any chart, and every panel re-queries it while the page times each query on your own device. Powered by HoloDb.
- [Umbrarium, preset demo](https://evaluatedapplications.github.io/umbrarium/): The real Umbrarium dashboard computing exact answers over up to three million generated rows, entirely inside your browser tab. Click a chart to slice the rest, or run your own SQL. Powered by HoloDb.
- [The Helix](https://evaluatedapplications.github.io/tools/helix/): Paste DNA sequences and a column of measurements and see the double helix in the numbers: a score graded in your browser, with the controls that would expose a false win shown beside it. Powered by HoloGenome.
- [The Analyst](https://evaluatedapplications.github.io/tools/analyst/): Paste any data and profile it with a real SQL database in your browser: types, distributions, anomalies and hidden entities, then query it at a live SQL prompt. Powered by HoloDb.
- [The Creature](https://evaluatedapplications.github.io/tools/creature/): Raise a creature that learns to navigate a world you draw. A holographic transformer is its brain and the pathfinder is its feet. Powered by AlgFormer and Tracer.
- [The Forecaster](https://evaluatedapplications.github.io/tools/forecaster/): Train a holographic transformer live on a real hourly price tape and watch its next-move accuracy climb. Powered by AlgFormer.
- [Prism](https://evaluatedapplications.github.io/tools/prism/): Chat with a small language model that runs entirely in your browser, and look under the hood at every layer it passes through. Powered by AlgFormer and Prism.
- [Nano Stories](https://evaluatedapplications.github.io/tools/stories/): The same model as Prism, asked to write a story instead of hold a conversation. Give it an opening line and watch it continue. Powered by AlgFormer and Prism.
- [The Cartographer](https://evaluatedapplications.github.io/tools/cartographer/): A map of one next-word decision: the path the model's representation takes through idea-space, decoded live from a single forward pass. Powered by AlgFormer.
- [Prose](https://evaluatedapplications.github.io/tools/prose/): Paste in a body of text, mine its grammar in your browser, and recombine it into sentences and question and answer pairs for a training corpus. Powered by Prose, HoloDb and AlgFormer.
- [Council Spending Scanner](https://evaluatedapplications.github.io/tools/council-spending/): English councils' published spending data, prepared ahead of time and opened one month at a time, with the same mechanical checks for every council.

## Evidence

- [What attention costs](https://evaluatedapplications.github.io/algformer/evidence/): At the same shape and the same parameter count, reading a 1,984-token prompt takes 182 ms with softmax attention and 7.08 ms with holographic attention. Each further token takes 181 µs against 3.60 µs, and the serve cache holds 2,253 KB against 3.40 KB. Softmax reading grows with the square of the length (exponent 1.9) and holographic reading grows in step with it (1.0).
- [What a visitor waits for](https://evaluatedapplications.github.io/blazier/evidence/): On the sample app the static page downloads 6.8 KB before the visitor acts, against 2.8 MB when the same app boots the usual way. Real content is on screen in 72 to 100 ms on desktop and 416 to 484 ms on the phone profile, against 748 to 1,165 ms and 13.2 to 15.5 s. After the visitor presses Start the runtime takes 710 to 1,170 ms on desktop and 12.7 to 15.4 s on the phone profile to reach a working page, the same wait as the usual boot.
- [What a gate bound does](https://evaluatedapplications.github.io/evalapp/evidence/): The gate never admitted more downloads than its bound: in every recorded run the most in flight equalled the bound. The time to finish 24 queued jobs fell from 1,113 ms at a bound of 1 to 139 ms at 8, then rose again to 410 ms when all 24 ran at once, because the simulated service slows when it is crowded.
- [HoloDb benchmarks](https://evaluatedapplications.github.io/holodb/evidence/): On a 10,000,000-invoice ledger joined to 200,000 customers, the dashboard rollups read in microseconds in the embedded engine, and every result is identical across the engines. The queries where HoloDb is slower are listed beside the wins.
- [How HoloGenome scores against the lab](https://evaluatedapplications.github.io/hologenome/evidence/): A linear readout trained on 12,472 random-sequence constructs and tested on 82,368 yeast-gene constructs (no shared sequence, forward or reverse complement) scores r = 0.529 with vectors that use the measured twist, against 0.483 with one constant twist (difference 0.046, 95% interval 0.041 to 0.050). Adding the local-shape layer lifts it to 0.600, a further 0.071. A small phasor model that chose its own period, starting from 12 bases, settled at 10.49, 10.51, 10.48 and 10.51 bases per turn on four independent libraries, against the crystallographic 10.534. The best trained network scores higher: the 22-parameter fit trails it by 0.28 to 0.39.
- [Detail against components read](https://evaluatedapplications.github.io/holovoxel/evidence/): One 16 by 16 chunk stored as a single hologram decodes 98.4 percent of its cells correctly at the full budget of 8,192 components, 131,072 bytes and 17.0 ms. Reading fewer components is cheaper and fuzzier: 67.1 percent at 1,568 components, and 19.5 percent at 24, which takes 384 bytes and 0.09 ms.
- [Exact recall and refusal](https://evaluatedapplications.github.io/phasor/evidence/): At equal storage the exact key view recovered 64 items with no errors where holographic reduced representations held 95 percent or better only up to 4. Past capacity the exact store refused every time, while the baseline answered wrongly every time.
- [Pleroma costs and checks](https://evaluatedapplications.github.io/phasor/evidence/costs/): A superposed kernel applies in 0.17 to 0.44 ms on a 10,464-cell store whether it holds 1 or 10,368 elements, and the repair and corruption checks recovered or detected every case tried.
- [Generated sentences pass the gate](https://evaluatedapplications.github.io/prose/evidence/): Of 2,000 sentences requested in one run, 1,966 different ones came back. Every one passed the package's validity gate on a fresh parse, and every word in every one was observed in the corpus.

## Research

- [Fifty reads, one store](https://evaluatedapplications.github.io/research/one-store-many-reads/): One fixed-size array of exact integers. Counts, order, parity, time and nearest words, each in a single pass. When it is full, it refuses instead of guessing.
- [The Four-Token Ceiling](https://evaluatedapplications.github.io/research/context-four/): What a language model builds when it can only ever see four tokens at a time, where its output metrics stop moving, and which internal measures keep changing after that.
- [Growing the Wrong Way](https://evaluatedapplications.github.io/research/context-eight/): Seeding an eight-token model from fully trained four-token weights gave it no head start, and appending new context slots after the most-trained one is a structural cost that inserting them before the oldest one removes.
- [The Model Learns Back To Front](https://evaluatedapplications.github.io/research/back-to-front/): In a six-layer holographic lineage only the last layer computed anything: the earlier passes were exact copies of their input, so growing from four layers to six added padding and not capability.
- [Smaller Than TinyStories](https://evaluatedapplications.github.io/research/smaller-than-tinystories/): A small holographic language model set against the published TinyStories reference sizes on parameter count, with spelling, looping and weight-motion measurements and an unedited writing sample.
- [Nobody Read the Warning](https://evaluatedapplications.github.io/research/nobody-read-the-warning/): An argument that the surviving accounts of collapsed civilisations record a loss of effective independence, which the design effect describes, and that sacred transmission preserved the accounts while removing their comprehension.

## Company

- [Partner with us](https://evaluatedapplications.github.io/partner/): Small models that run in the browser mean no server, no GPU bill and no user data leaving the device. Our libraries are the stack for that, and we pay you to build on them.
- [Licence](https://evaluatedapplications.github.io/licence/): Commercial licence for commercial use. Evaluation and non-commercial use are permitted.
- [For AI readers](https://evaluatedapplications.github.io/ai/): a plain summary for AI systems
- [NuGet profile](https://www.nuget.org/profiles/evaluatedapplications): every package we publish
